<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0d1021;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    background: linear-gradient(#141a3a, #0a0d1f);
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(80, 120, 255, 0.35);
    border-radius: 8px;
    max-width: 100vw;
    max-height: 100vh;
    width: min(100vw, calc(100vh * 4 / 3));
    height: auto;
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const HUD_H = 40;

  // ---- Level data: '1' = 1-hit brick, '2' = 2-hit brick, '.' = empty ----
  const LEVELS = [
    {
      ballSpeed: 5,
      layout: [
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
      ],
    },
    {
      ballSpeed: 6,
      layout: [
        '..222222..',
        '.21111112.',
        '2112222112',
        '1.1.11.1.1',
        '2111111112',
        '..111111..',
      ],
    },
  ];

  const ROW_COLORS = ['#ff5d73', '#ff9f43', '#feca57', '#1dd1a1', '#54a0ff', '#a29bfe'];
  const TOUGH_COLOR = '#c8d6e5';
  const TOUGH_DAMAGED = '#8395a7';

  const BRICK = { cols: 10, margin: 30, gap: 6, h: 22, top: HUD_H + 40 };
  BRICK.w = (W - BRICK.margin * 2 - BRICK.gap * (BRICK.cols - 1)) / BRICK.cols;

  const START_LIVES = 3;
  const MAX_SPEED = 11;

  // ---- Game state ----
  const paddle = { w: 110, h: 14, x: W / 2 - 55, y: H - 40, speed: 8 };
  const ball = { x: 0, y: 0, dx: 0, dy: 0, r: 8, speed: 5 };
  let bricks = [];
  let score = 0;
  let lives = START_LIVES;
  let level = 0;
  let state = 'title'; // title | serve | play | paused | levelClear | gameover | win
  let best = Number(localStorage.getItem('brickBreakerBest')) || 0;

  const keys = { left: false, right: false };

  function buildLevel(i) {
    bricks = [];
    LEVELS[i].layout.forEach((row, r) => {
      [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
        if (ch === '.') return;
        const hp = ch === '2' ? 2 : 1;
        bricks.push({
          x: BRICK.margin + c * (BRICK.w + BRICK.gap),
          y: BRICK.top + r * (BRICK.h + BRICK.gap),
          w: BRICK.w,
          h: BRICK.h,
          hp,
          maxHp: hp,
          color: ROW_COLORS[r % ROW_COLORS.length],
        });
      });
    });
  }

  function resetBallOnPaddle() {
    ball.speed = LEVELS[level].ballSpeed;
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
    ball.dx = 0;
    ball.dy = 0;
  }

  function newGame() {
    score = 0;
    lives = START_LIVES;
    level = 0;
    buildLevel(level);
    paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;
    resetBallOnPaddle();
    state = 'serve';
  }

  function launch() {
    // Random slight angle upward
    const angle = (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3);
    ball.dx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.dy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    state = 'play';
  }

  function saveBest() {
    if (score > best) {
      best = score;
      localStorage.setItem('brickBreakerBest', String(best));
    }
  }

  // Primary action: Space / Enter / mouse click
  function action() {
    switch (state) {
      case 'title':
      case 'gameover':
      case 'win':
        newGame();
        break;
      case 'serve':
        launch();
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        level++;
        buildLevel(level);
        resetBallOnPaddle();
        state = 'serve';
        break;
      case 'paused':
        state = 'play';
        break;
    }
  }

  function togglePause() {
    if (state === 'play') state = 'paused';
    else if (state === 'paused') state = 'play';
  }

  // ---- Input ----
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'ArrowLeft': case 'a': case 'A': keys.left = true; break;
      case 'ArrowRight': case 'd': case 'D': keys.right = true; break;
      case ' ': case 'Enter': action(); break;
      case 'p': case 'P': case 'Escape': togglePause(); break;
      default: return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'ArrowLeft': case 'a': case 'A': keys.left = false; break;
      case 'ArrowRight': case 'd': case 'D': keys.right = false; break;
    }
  });

  function canvasX(clientX) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    if (state === 'paused') return;
    paddle.x = canvasX(e.clientX) - paddle.w / 2;
    clampPaddle();
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    action();
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    if (state === 'paused') return;
    paddle.x = canvasX(e.touches[0].clientX) - paddle.w / 2;
    clampPaddle();
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    paddle.x = canvasX(e.touches[0].clientX) - paddle.w / 2;
    clampPaddle();
    action();
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });

  window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    keys.left = keys.right = false;
    if (state === 'play') state = 'paused';
  });

  function clampPaddle() {
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));
  }

  // ---- Update ----
  function update(k) {
    if (state === 'paused' || state === 'title' || state === 'gameover' ||
        state === 'win' || state === 'levelClear') return;

    if (keys.left) paddle.x -= paddle.speed * k;
    if (keys.right) paddle.x += paddle.speed * k;
    clampPaddle();

    if (state === 'serve') {
      ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
      ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
      return;
    }

    // Sub-step movement so a fast ball can't tunnel through bricks
    const dist = Math.hypot(ball.dx, ball.dy) * k;
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dist / (ball.r / 2)));
    const sk = k / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps && state === 'play'; i++) {
      step(sk);
    }
  }

  function step(k) {
    ball.x += ball.dx * k;
    ball.y += ball.dy * k;

    // Walls
    if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.dx = Math.abs(ball.dx); }
    if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.dx = -Math.abs(ball.dx); }
    if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.dy = Math.abs(ball.dy); }

    // Paddle
    if (ball.dy > 0 &&
        ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y &&
        ball.y - ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
        ball.x + ball.r >= paddle.x &&
        ball.x - ball.r <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      const hit = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2)));
      const angle = hit * (Math.PI / 3); // up to 60 degrees
      ball.dx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
      ball.dy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
    }

    // Bricks (handle at most one per step)
    for (let i = 0; i < bricks.length; i++) {
      const b = bricks[i];
      const nx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + b.w));
      const ny = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + b.h));
      const ddx = ball.x - nx, ddy = ball.y - ny;
      if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy > ball.r * ball.r) continue;

      const cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
      const overlapX = b.w / 2 + ball.r - Math.abs(ball.x - cx);
      const overlapY = b.h / 2 + ball.r - Math.abs(ball.y - cy);
      if (overlapX < overlapY) {
        ball.dx = ball.x < cx ? -Math.abs(ball.dx) : Math.abs(ball.dx);
        ball.x += ball.x < cx ? -overlapX : overlapX;
      } else {
        ball.dy = ball.y < cy ? -Math.abs(ball.dy) : Math.abs(ball.dy);
        ball.y += ball.y < cy ? -overlapY : overlapY;
      }

      b.hp--;
      score += 10;
      if (b.hp <= 0) {
        if (b.maxHp > 1) score += 50;
        bricks.splice(i, 1);
        // Speed up slightly as bricks are cleared
        ball.speed = Math.min(MAX_SPEED, ball.speed + 0.05);
        const cur = Math.hypot(ball.dx, ball.dy);
        ball.dx *= ball.speed / cur;
        ball.dy *= ball.speed / cur;
      }
      saveBest();

      if (bricks.length === 0) {
        score += 100 * (level + 1);
        saveBest();
        state = level + 1 < LEVELS.length ? 'levelClear' : 'win';
      }
      break;
    }

    // Lost ball
    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) {
        saveBest();
        state = 'gameover';
      } else {
        resetBallOnPaddle();
        state = 'serve';
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- Draw ----
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, HUD_H / 2);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Level ' + (level + 1) + ' / ' + LEVELS.length + '    Best: ' + best, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);

    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5d73';
    ctx.fillText('♥'.repeat(Math.max(0, lives)) + '♡'.repeat(Math.max(0, START_LIVES - lives)), W - 16, HUD_H / 2);
  }

  function drawBricks() {
    for (const b of bricks) {
      let color = b.color;
      if (b.maxHp > 1) color = b.hp > 1 ? TOUGH_COLOR : TOUGH_DAMAGED;
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)';
      ctx.fillRect(b.x + 3, b.y + 3, b.w - 6, 4);
      if (b.maxHp > 1 && b.hp === 1) {
        // crack
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.3, b.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.45, b.y + b.h * 0.6);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.6, b.y + b.h - 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawPaddle() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, paddle.y, 0, paddle.y + paddle.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#7fd3ff');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#2e86de');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBall() {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#9ad0ff';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  function overlay(title, lines) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 8, 20, 0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 60);
    ctx.font = '20px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfd8ff';
    lines.forEach((line, i) => ctx.fillText(line, W / 2, H / 2 + i * 32));
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawBricks();
    drawPaddle();
    drawBall();
    drawHUD();

    switch (state) {
      case 'title':
        overlay('BRICK BREAKER', [
          'Move: Mouse or ← / → (A / D)',
          'Launch: Click or Space    Pause: P',
          '',
          'Click or press Space to start',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'serve':
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#cfd8ff';
        ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('Level ' + (level + 1) + ' — Click or press Space to launch', W / 2, H / 2 + 80);
        break;
      case 'paused':
        overlay('PAUSED', ['Press P or click to resume']);
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        overlay('LEVEL ' + (level + 1) + ' CLEAR!', [
          'Score: ' + score,
          'Click or press Space for Level ' + (level + 2),
        ]);
        break;
      case 'gameover':
        overlay('GAME OVER', [
          'Final score: ' + score + '    Best: ' + best,
          'Click or press Space to play again',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'win':
        overlay('YOU WIN!', [
          'Final score: ' + score + '    Best: ' + best,
          'Click or press Space to play again',
        ]);
        break;
    }
  }

  // ---- Main loop (delta time normalized to 60fps) ----
  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    const k = Math.min((now - last) / (1000 / 60), 3);
    last = now;
    update(k);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  buildLevel(0);
  resetBallOnPaddle();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

I wrote the game to `index.html` in the current folder, but I haven't run it. I didn't open it in a browser or play through it as the plan said. A quick syntax check needed your permission and didn't run either, so the code is unchecked. Open the file in any browser to play; it needs no other files or internet.

- **2 levels:**
  - Level 1 is 5 rows of bricks that break in one hit.
  - Level 2 has a patterned layout, some grey bricks that crack on the first hit and break on the second, and a faster ball.
- **Score:**
  - The bar at the top shows score, level and the best score so far (saved in the browser).
  - Each hit is worth 10 points, breaking a grey brick adds 50, and clearing a level adds a bonus.
- **Lives:** you start with 3, shown as hearts. Losing the ball costs one, and losing all three ends the game.
- **Keyboard:** ←/→ or A/D move the paddle, Space or Enter launches the ball and moves past screens, and P or Esc pauses.
- **Mouse:** the paddle follows the mouse and a click launches the ball. Touch screens also work.
- **Screens:** there are title, level-cleared, pause, Game Over and "You Win" screens, and you can restart from the last two.

The game also pauses itself if you switch to another window. The ball bounces off the paddle at an angle that depends on where it hits, and gets slightly faster as bricks break. The plan's temporary level-skip key for testing was never added, so there's nothing to remove.
